_about: Per-lead values for the detailing template v1 (iv_detailing_video_hi_v1). body_params = [{{1}}, {{2}}] EXACTLY as they must be passed to propose.py wa-template / wa.py send-template as two --body-param values, in this order. Phone numbers are deliberately NOT here (they stay in the console lead entries and are never printed). Written 29 Oct 2026. Nothing was sent, created, submitted or deployed.

template.name: iv_detailing_video_hi_v1
template.language_flag: --lang hi   (wa.py defaults to en and never compares it with the template: a forgotten flag fails with Meta error 132001 AFTER the owner's OK code is spent)

variables.1: the studio's short name = brand_short below (it follows 'नमस्ते' and is followed by 'टीम')
variables.2: ONE literally-true observation from the 5-sentence dictionary below; no closing danda (the body puts '।' right after it)

template.lead_label_flag: --lead "<lead_label>"  (becomes lead_ref in the CRM ledger and the hand-off name; owner-test sends must start with 'Owner test')
template.propose_pattern: PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python agent/tools/propose.py wa-template --to <91XXXXXXXXXX> --template iv_detailing_video_hi_v1 --lang hi --body-param "<body_params[0]>" --body-param "<body_params[1]>" --header-video-url <public https mp4> --lead "<lead_label>" --reason "<slot, evidence, number label>" --no-notify --ttl-hours 2
template.send_pattern: python agent/tools/wa.py send-template --to <91XXXXXXXXXX> --template iv_detailing_video_hi_v1 --lang hi --body-param "<body_params[0]>" --body-param "<body_params[1]>" --header-video-url <public https mp4> --lead "<lead_label>" --live --approval <CODE>
template.header_video_url: NOT HOSTED YET. A send needs a public https .mp4 served as video/mp4 (template creation does not). Hosting needs the owner's 'deploy it'.

value_rules: Every value is ONE line: no newline, no tab, no run of 5 or more spaces, no empty value (Meta send errors 132012/132018 come AFTER the owner's OK code is spent).
No double quote inside a value (PowerShell 5.1 strips it). The apostrophe in Walker's must be the plain ASCII apostrophe (U+0027).
Exactly 2 --body-param values. The values below were linted: no URL, no {{ }}, no emoji, no invisible characters, all NFC-normalised.
{{2}} comes ONLY from this fixed dictionary, never from scraped text. Re-check the sentence on the send day (listing facts expire in about 3 days) and record the result in the approval reason.

ONE number per brand (the listing's own Maps number), never the boss's personal number, never a landline (norm_phone refuses it), one lead at a time, about 60 s wait and a status read before the next.
Never mention their ads, offers or prices; never say 'you need a website'.

send_order_note: Default order = slot-verifier order (strongest, most stable slots first). Arihant is a HOLD. Alternative the owner may choose: start with the numbers that have WhatsApp evidence (Krishna Auto Coating, Walker's, Detailing Xpert, DNX). At most 3 sends on day 1, and only if the owner-number test passed. 3 consecutive non-deliveries = cold templates OFF.
